title: unified-rollouts-proactive-shadow-canary-auto-rollback-policy
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Adds proactive auto-rollback policy for shadow + canary rollouts: multi-metric thresholds, configurable lookback windows, and safe-fallback routing. Backwards-compatible config schema migration and console UI additions.
description: Motivation: we observed several rollouts that only tripped late because shadow traffic anomalies were detected after canary ramps completed. This PR implements a proactive auto-rollback policy that evaluates shadow + canary signals in real-time and triggers safe rollbacks before user-facing impact. Design highlights: 1) new policy type 'proactive_auto_rollback' that can be attached to unified rollouts; 2) policy evaluates multiple metrics (latency P95, error-rate, model-quality regressions via eval hooks) with per-metric thresholds, weightings, and configurable lookback windows; 3) shadow traffic is used as an early-warning signal - anomalies in shadow are correlated with canary to avoid false positives; 4) rollout controller will only enact rollback when confidence score exceeds threshold and fallback routing is available; 5) includes canary pacing tweaks to allow short detection windows between increments. This is backward compatible with existing canary/AB/shadow policies; the default is disabled for existing rollouts. Implementation: - Controller changes (services/rollouts/controller.go): new policy evaluation loop, confidence scoring, and safe-rollback orchestration. - API (api/v1/rollout.proto + api/v1/rollout_types.go): added policy schema fields (metrics[], lookback_seconds, weightings, min_shadow_volume). Schema migration path preserved by adding optional fields. - Console (web/console/src/components/rollout/*): UI to create/edit proactive auto-rollback policies and a visualization of recent metric signals and computed confidence. - Runtime (serving/metrics/aggregator): efficient streaming aggregator to compute metric deltas and detect short spikes in shadow traffic without blocking request paths. - E2E tests and unit tests added under test/rollouts to cover policy evaluation and rollback decision logic. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-4782) - [x] Controller implementation - [x] API additions and proto update - [x] Console UI for policy management - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Migration/compatibility verified - [x] Manual smoke test in staging (shadow+canary with synthetic regressions) Backwards compatibility and migration: New fields are optional. Existing rollouts continue to behave the same. Admins can opt-in per-rollout. Rollout YAML example included in docs. Operational notes: - Default lookback is conservative (60s) and confidence threshold is high to avoid spurious rollbacks. - Metrics used for automatic rollback are configurable and can include custom eval hooks for model quality. - When rollback is triggered, a 'protected period' prevents immediate re-rollout for a configurable cooldown. Risks and mitigations: - False positives: mitigated via multi-metric weighting and requiring correlation between shadow and canary signals. - Metric instrumentation gaps: added sampler and alerting to surface missing metrics. - Rollback safety: rollback requires a viable fallback target; controller will not delete a variant mid-flight. See changed files for implementation details and test notes.

review_comments: Ravi Patel: Overall looks great. A few questions: 1) How do we prevent noisy shadow signals from causing rollbacks in low-traffic customers? 2) Can we add a dry-run mode that records decisions without acting?
Ava Chen: Answered inline - we have min_shadow_volume and weighted multi-metric checks. Added a dry_run config flag and tests to simulate decision path without enacting rollback.
Samira Khan: Found a race in controller when a rollout is updated during evaluation - suggested adding a generation check before applying state changes.
Ava Chen: Fixed in services/rollouts/controller.go: added generation check and retry with backoff. Added unit test to cover the case.
Lucas Moreno: CI failed on lint initially (TSX formatting); thanks for the fix. Approved after e2e green.
Ravi Patel: Approving; documented operational runbook concerns about cooldown and metrics ownership.
merge_note: Squashed and merged after approvals. Migration is opt-in and guarded by feature flag for 2 weeks; rollout to customers will be gradual.
